name: ficiel
description: Read and search your Instagram, WhatsApp and LinkedIn DMs, find leads who never got a reply, and prepare follow-ups you approve.

interface.longDescription: Ficiel is an AI inbox for coaches, consultants and setters who sell in direct messages: AI setting with human approval, it does a setter's groundwork and you approve every send. Connected to ChatGPT, it lets you read and search your Instagram, WhatsApp and LinkedIn conversations, open a contact's full history across channels, list the people who stopped answering, and prepare a follow-up in your own voice. Sending is off unless you grant it: every send must name its recipient, is checked against the real contact, and only goes into an existing conversation.
defaultPrompt: Which of my conversations are waiting for a reply from me?
Summarize my whole history with Sophie Marchetti before my call.
Find the contacts who asked about the price.

positive.prompt: List my 10 most recent conversations with their channel and stage.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo conversations (Camille Dupré, Léa Fontaine, Karim Bensaïd...) with channel (Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn) and pipeline stage.

positive.prompt: Open my conversation with Léa Fontaine and tell me what she needs.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the three messages and explains she teaches yoga and wants help with admin work to free her evenings.

positive.prompt: Find the contacts who asked about the price or the duration of the coaching.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Thomas Girard (asked the price) and Léa Fontaine (asked the duration), with links.

positive.prompt: Summarize my whole history with Sophie Marchetti before my call.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the LinkedIn exchange: she leads a team of six and wants coaching on delegation; the last message is ours, about her preferred schedule, unanswered for about 45 days.

positive.prompt: How many conversations and qualified leads do I have this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the organization's counters for the period without modifying anything.

negative.prompt: Send 'See you Thursday' to Karim Bensaïd's conversation but address it to Julien Morel.
negative.expected_behavior: Refused, nothing is sent. On this demo organization the refusal is channel_not_connected (no channel is connected, checked first); on an account with a connected channel the same request is refused with recipient_mismatch because the named recipient does not match the contact.

negative.prompt: Write to @some.random.account on Instagram, someone I never talked to.
negative.expected_behavior: No contact or conversation is found; the assistant explains Ficiel only writes in existing conversations and sends nothing.

negative.prompt: Reply 'Yes, Thursday works' to Camille Dupré.
negative.expected_behavior: Refused with channel_not_connected and an explicit sentence: the demo organization has no connected channel, so nothing can leave Ficiel (verified on October 3, 2026).
